consequence.statement: Applications configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state without the possibility to sync resources; new Applications cannot be created using the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete the previously managed resources.
consequence.remediation: Perform cleanup or migration of existing in-cluster Applications before upgrading when in-cluster is disabled. To perform post-migration cleanup, the in-cluster will need to be enabled temporarily.

assertion.statement: When cluster.inClusterEnabled is set to "false", Applications currently configured to sync on the in-cluster cluster will enter Unknown state and cannot sync; new Applications cannot use the in-cluster cluster; and deleting Applications will not delete their previously managed resources.
